DARV.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CH: Welcome! Every piece in this collection has over a thousand years of history!
Do you have any treasures from Eastern Wu?
…I don't collect things belonging to those rats.
Borrowing again? You still haven't returned what you took last time.
I've saved something especially for you. It might just keep you alive.
My two brothers and I bow before you. You have our deepest thanks.
Just so we're clear: no more paying with promises to repay me someday.
DARV.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CH: Another newcomer? [jitter]The Spire's future is bright![/jitter]
You may be a pedant, but the [gold][b]wine[/b][/gold] you've collected is excellent.
…Someone actually thinks a thousand-year-old drink is good because it was worth keeping?
That “[red][b]Heaven[/b][/red]” you mentioned earlier—something much like it seems to exist in the Spire.
My new friend, I have [b]something good[/b] for you!
You're an honest fellow after all!
Remarkable. The first thing out of your mouth is the plain truth.
NEOW.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CH: You there! Tell [gold][b]Anthony[/b][/gold] to come and greet his emperor!
[sine]…For…two months…not a word…whether he lives…or dies…unknown…[/sine]
Why recite poetry now? Another useless pedant!
Heaven's will. It is all Heaven's will.
NEOW.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CH: And you are…? My apologies, I simply cannot recall your name. Would you happen to know where [gold][b]Anthony[/b][/gold] is?
Not bad. Your way with verse is a match for mine.
[sine]…You…returned…from crushing defeat……an army burning for revenge…[/sine]
[jitter]And such an army is bound to win![/jitter]
NONUPEIPE.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_H: Those rags hardly befit a kinsman of the Han emperor. Let me find you something lovely!
Where are the clothes I gave you last time? Why are you back in that old outfit?
The Architect's fury has set the whole Spire ablaze!
Even finer than the flames of Yiling?
NONUPEIPE.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_W: I have not received a visitor in thousands of years! Oh my, your outfit is rather dull. Come, let us pick out something lovely for you to wear.
A visitor sent by [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red] deserves a blessing all his own. Servants! Pour us some wine.
The Architect has gone mad! His wrath is flooding the entire Spire!
Do not be angry. Anger dulls your wisdom.
I have prepared gifts for you. Take them, take plenty.
OROBAS.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_: Tell me! What fun stories do you have in your world?!
We four brothers—Liu, Guan, Zhang, and Zhao—swore an oath in the Peach Garden. Though not born on the same day…
That's a version I've never heard!! What happened next?! What happened next?!
That strategist of yours who can foresee the future—did he predict you would come here?
He did. He said, "My lord, [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red] says you took the wrong road again."
Tell me about your three visits to the thatched cottage again! Why did it take three visits?!
I didn't draw him the first two times.
OROBAS.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_: A newcomer from another world? And only half a body? How interesting!!
[red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red] sent me to kill the Architect and find the missing [gold][b]Anthony[/b][/gold]!
What a fascinating premise! Tell me more!! Tell me more!!
Would you tell me again those little Spire stories you foresaw through [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red]?
Very well. [gold][b]Anthony[/b][/gold] and his old man, [red][b]Bowlbug (Rock)[/b][/red], lived alone in a small house on a hill…
Explain to me one more time what [rainbow][b]325[/b][/rainbow] means!!
You really are hopeless. Sit tight now. (Ten thousand words omitted here.)
PAEL.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CH: The wind follows the tiger, the clouds follow the dragon; heroes of dragon and tiger stand proud beneath the heavens.

[thinky_dots]Another stranger has come…
Take a piece for the road…[/thinky_dots]
This Pael looks like a sleeping dragon too. And a dragon is the very sign of an emperor!

[thinky_dots]Say what you like…
Take a piece for the road…[/thinky_dots]
Let me light a fire. We'll see if that gets you up!
PAEL.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CH: (Loudly) Wine! And song! How long! Is life!
[thinky_dots]Keep it down…there is still plenty of life left…[/thinky_dots]
Death is a cool summer night, where a man may sleep without a care.
TANX.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CH:
[b]A half-bodied man?!
Fighting with two swords?![/b]
Don't force me to draw my merciless sword!
[b]Come!! Let us put an edge on that benevolence and righteousness of yours!![/b]
[i][font_size=22]A montage of fiercely spliced fight-scene shots.[/font_size][/i]
Wine can be a weapon too?
TANX.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CH: All fifteen thousand troops in the city. I led every last one of them out through the enemy.
[b]Good!! Let me give each of them a weapon!![/b]
[i][font_size=22]A montage of fiercely spliced fight-scene shots.[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_H: Wahaha! We have a new guest! Hello there, little one~
I am Liu Bei. My respects.
What an exotic name! Come, Mr. Yuri, have something to eat.
Let me make your flame [jitter][b]burn a little brighter[/b][/jitter]!!!
What a fine fire—even better than the flames of Yiling!
Come, little one! You need enough wine in you to keep going!
TEZCATARA.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_W: Hello, little one! What's your name?
A humble merchant from Pei. My family name is Huangfu; my given name is Zhang.
Got it, Mengde! Sit down before the food gets cold!
Let me make your flame [jitter][b]burn a little brighter[/b][/jitter]!!!
I heard that one at Red Cliffs too.
Welcome back, Destined One! Come to stack up a revenge-bent army against the Architect again?
VAKUU.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_C: You want to restore your dynasty? I can make everyone obey you.
Even those who would rather not.
Give me your body. I will look after your Han dynasty for you.
Your benevolence and righteousness cannot save you. Let me take over. Everything will be so much easier!
Insolence! Are you lecturing me? I will have your head!
VAKUU.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_C: Perhaps this [red][b]Heaven[/b][/red] and I will have a great deal to talk about…
Stop letting [red][b]Heaven[/b][/red] take you over. Let me take hold of you for a while—I promise you won't regret it!
[red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red], our goals are the same.
([red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red]'s voice comes down from the sky) [i][font_size=22][gold][b]Tony[/b][/gold] gets your meaning.[/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_S: Left General of Han, Marquis of Yicheng, Governor of Yu Province, Imperial Uncle Liu…
Liu who? Guan who? Never heard of you.
What makes you think you can defeat me?
Do you take your emperor for a fool in matters of war?
Then you and your soldiers can disappear together!
I've fought all my life! Can't I enjoy myself? Let the music play! Let the dancing continue!
Xuande, it was not I who ruined you—it was this age of chaos that ruined you!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_C: Tell him a wanted man is here to visit: Cao Mengde, who failed to assassinate Dong Zhuo. Bring Cao Cao's head to the capital, and the court will reward you with a thousand gold and make you a marquis of ten thousand households!
What is this gibberish? I don't understand a word of it.
What is your connection to that ninja who is only half a body?
Perhaps the world misjudged Cao Cao yesterday, and misjudges him again today, and will misjudge him again tomorrow—but I am still myself, and I have never feared being misjudged.
How did you come running into my tower again?
As long as I, Cao Mengde, still draw breath, he is undefeatable!
A-Man, it was not I who ruined you—it was this age of chaos that ruined you!
